stage: P5.16 D0 / T0.2-ipopt-interior (one declared IPOPT solve)
objective_convention: gross_operational_cost (settlement-EXCLUDED, salvage NOT subtracted) per group; Q_cert+ = gross with every detector slack at max(slack, 0) (spec section 12 ruling 5); gap = Q_cert+ - Q_LB; variant C (calendar-only)

implied_rhs0_equality_rows_all_columns_p.note: rhs-0 rows whose every column is pinned by other rows: linearly dependent on them (a rank deficiency of the zero cone present in the LP itself)

pinned_columns.rule: pinned: fixed at LB = UB = 0, or the only unpinned nonzero column of an = row with rhs exactly 0 (iterated); a Lorentz cone with a pinned head is replaced by zero rows sqrt(d_i) x_i = 0

equality_rank.method: connected components of the bipartite row-column graph (scipy.sparse.csgraph); per component dense singular values (scipy.linalg.svdvals); numerical rank = #{sigma > sigma_max_k * max(m_k, n_k) * eps} (numpy matrix_rank default tolerance, per component); deficiency = m_k - rank_k (includes m_k - n_k when a component has more rows than columns); dependent rows named as the non-pivot columns of a pivoted QR of the component transpose (scipy.linalg.qr(pivoting=True)) -- one admissible choice, not unique

quadratic_inventory.note: a Lorentz cone with a pinned head (t = 0 forced by rhs-0 equality chains) is {x = 0}: no strict interior, and the smooth row sum d x^2 - e t^2 <= 0 has a vanishing gradient at every feasible point (no constraint qualification there); built as written, per p516_d0_t02

start.definition: T0.1c certified mapped point (p516_d0_t02.certified_point, variant C calendar factor), clipped into the LP bounds by build_ipopt_model

cone_slacks.definition: a cone / circle is active when its relative slack is <= 1e-6 (rotated: (k u v - sum d x^2) / (k u v); circle: (r - sum d x^2) / r; Lorentz: (e t^2 - sum d x^2) / (e t^2)); a row whose scale (k u v, e t^2 or r) is <= 1e-12 has no relative slack and is reported by its absolute slack (scale - sum d x^2)

multiplier_sign_convention.definition: pi_gurobi_convention = sign * pyomo dual; bound multipliers z = ipopt_zL_out + ipopt_zU_out (as p516_d0_t02.ipopt_solve)
